caseNameFull: Mazer, doing business as June Lamp Manufacturing Co. v. Stein, doing business as Reglor of California

opinions.text: Certiorari, ante, p. 811, to the United States Court of Appeals for the Fourth Circuit. The application of the Solicitor General for leave to appear and present oral argument on behalf of the Register of Copyrights, as amicus curiae, is granted.
